Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) The Commercial Vehicles hired shall be for official use by DY.CEE/GS/SC/South Central Railway, Secund erabad on a Regular basis. The Vehicle will be used as per directions given by Dy.CEE/GS/SC for official p urpose for a period of 24 months. The base location shall be Hyderabad (Telangana).

2) EVALUATION CRITERION: The tenderer is required to upload the following mandatory documents along with the bid offer, failing by which the offer will be summarily rejected. 3) AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Telangana for better coordination and service. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. DETAILS OF VEHICLE: 01 Vehicle (AC SUV) should be registered in the name of Tenderer and should not sublet any part of the contract. However, the Tenderer can have Lease Agreement with the owner of the ve hicle/cab aggregator on non-judicial stamp paper for the tenure of the contract, which should be submitted along with the bid. The vehicle proposed to be offered on hire should be in good condition and not more th an 4 years old, on the date of opening of tender. The Tenderer is required to submit the COMMERCIAL VEHI CLE REGISTRATION DETAILS along with supporting documents of the vehicle fulfilling the category, specific ations along with the tender, failing to submit the same along with the bid, the offer will be summarily reje cted. Bids of other than commercial vehicles should be summarily rejected. c) PERFORMANCE DETAILS: Along with tender, bidders to enclose the list of ongoing vehicle hire contracts with Railways, Other Central Government Departments, State Government and PSUs in the same city/locat ion/agglomeration with details of Contract Period, rate per month, Vehicle Class , Model and brand, Fuel (D iesel/Petrol/ LPG/CNG/Electric/Hybrid), procurement cost (ex showroom price) etc. Submission of this state ment, even if Nil, shall be mandatory enclosure to the tender failing which the offer will be summarilyreject ed. [Proforma as per document Annexure III of scope of work document] d) Submission of undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents - The bidders shall submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents submitted/ uploaded along with the tender. Th is shall be mandatory for all the bidders. In case of failure of the bidder to submit the undertaking, their off er shall be summarily rejected [Proforma as per Annexure-I of scope of work document] e) Declaration of the details of the engagement of Retired/Existing Railway Employees. Declaration regardi ng site visit, compliance of statutory laws, penalty for violation of labour laws, Non blacklisting, termination of contracts etc. Self-declaration of the undertaking by the bidder that My/our firm/ Company is not under li quidation court receivership or similar proceedings and has not suffered bankruptcy/insolvency during the l ast 5 years. [Proforma as per Annexure-IV of scope of work document f) CONSTITUTION OF FIRM: The bidder shall give full details of the constitution of the Firm/Company/Societ y etc. and shall also submit following documents (as applicable), in addition to documents mentioned abov e. (i) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarized copy of the affidavit or GST certificate in dicating Proprietorship certificate. (ii) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (i) registered/notarized Partnership De ed and (ii) Power of Attorney duly authorising one or more of the partners of the firm or any other persons( s), authorised by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreem ent, witness measurements, sign Measurement Books, receive payment, make correspondences, compro mise/settle/ relinquish any claim (s) preferred by the firm, sign 'No Claim certificate', refer all or any disput e to arbitration and to take similar action in respect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. (iii) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall submit (i) the copies of MOA (Memor andum of Association) and AOA (Articles of Association) of the Company; and (ii) Power of Attorney duly re gistered/notarized by the company (backed by the resolution of Board of Directors) in favour of the individ

ual, signing the Bid on behalf of the Company. (iv) Society: The bidder shall submit (i) Self- attested copy of the certificate of Registration, (ii) Deed of For mation and (iii) Power of Attorney in favour of the tender signatory. (v) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Venture (JV) not permitted /not allowed in this tender. Bidder's offer is liable to b e rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, .Buyer Add ed Bid Specific Additional Terms and Conditions and Corrigendum if any. Post tender opening no new docu ments will be considered for bid evaluation even at representation stage. 3) The contractor/agency participating in the tender should normally be GST compliant regarding registrati on, filing of returns etc., and shall be fully responsible for the compliance as per GST Act at all times. If the Contractor falls either “below the turnover threshold for GST” or is a “Composition Taxable Person” under t he CGST Act, a self-declaration should be enclosed with his offer duly supported by a certificate of turnover from a Chartered Accountant or enclose Form ‘REG-06’ showing as “Composition” under Type of Registrati on and no GST is applicable for contracts with such persons/firms. GST for vehicle rental/hire services falls under SAC code 9966, as per which, the present applicable rate is 5% (2.5% CGST+2.5% SGST) for vehicle s designed to carry men and materials where cost of fuel is included in the rate. 4) Once the contract is awarded, the service provider needs to submit Driver’s details to the consignee an d driver should have passed a minimum of 10th standard and possess a valid driving licence, Aadhar Card on his name and employee identification card issued by the Contractor at all times. The verification of driv er details, Driving license, Aadhar Card etc. .has to be done by consignee. 5) The vehicle’s should be available on all days including holidays as per requirement of the user for officia l duty 6) In reference to SLA clause no.5.11 and 5.12, the substitute vehicle’s offered shall not be older than the vehicle under breakdown at any point of time during the currency of contract. The condition and upkeep of substitute vehicle shall be same as that of approved vehicle’s in the contract. 7) The contractor shall be responsible for providing the vehicles at any point of time in day or night, even a t short notice during any urgency/emergency. Hiring for 12 hours in a day means continuous hiring for 12h ours during day or 12 hours during night. No advance payment shall be made and all payments released o n completion of stipulated service periodically/monthly as stipulated. In case, on any day, the vehicle was utilised for more than 12 hours on exceptional/ emergency requirement, relaxation to that extent may bep rovided in subsequent days to the Contractor/firm. 8) Imposition of penalties is as per Para 8 of GeM SLA. 9) The SLA clause 4.2 sub clause (1) & (2) for payment of extra kilo meter and extra hours shall not be app licable to this contract. In any month, vehicle run can be more or less than the scale of Number of 2500KM /month but shall not exceed cumulative KM 30,000 per year for SUV Non A/C vehicle. Payment will be mad e on a monthly basis as per accepted monthly rate irrespective of actual KM run in that month. No further variation in KM is either allowed or to be paid. The rate quoted shall be inclusive of salary of driver, daily b atta, fuel, petrol/diesel, other consumables, regular maintenance, expenses and other expenditure toward s repairs, taxes etc

10) Price variation Clause is not applicable in this tender. 11) A Log Book for each vehicle shall be maintained by the Contractor for the hired vehicles. The KM utilis ed shall be entered in it on a daily basis to ensure proper account and payment at the end of every month /specified period. It is the responsibility of the official using the vehicle to keep the log book up to date and the vehicle is used for the official duties/works. Statement of entries as per Log Book should be enclosed w ith the bills submitted for payment by the service provider/contractor duly counter signed by the official to who/under whose custody the vehicle is placed except that in case of vehicles hired for DRMs/PHODs/AGM/ GM, this statement shall be countersigned by nominated officer in the secretariat. In case of pooled vehicl es, Secretary to PHOD or ADRM or nominated in charge Gazetted Officer will sign the Log Book/statement sent with bills thereof, as the case may be. 12) The vehicle contract can be short-closed with three months notice, if the post of the officer is surrende red or the officer opts for drawl of transport allowance or any other administrative reason (except unsatisf actory service, which will be as per penalty clause of SLA). In this regard, the following conditions will be a pplicable: The Railway has liberty to short-close the contract with any or all of the service providers normal ly with three months' notice without assigning any reason. However, in case a service provider wants to sh ort close his services, he will have to serve 4 months advance written notice. a. The contract for the vehicles hired can also be terminated with a short notice of 15 days on account of uns atisfactory services at the discretion of the Officer in charge of hiring of vehicles. The unsatisfactory servic e shall mean and include the non-compliance of any of the obligations by the service provider, as given in this agreement and/or under the penalty clauses of the SLA of GeM contract or repeated breach. b. In case of any dispute of any kind, the Contractor/ Agency shall abide by the decision of the controlling aut hority or Nodal Officer or Buyer in charge of hiring of the vehicle as the case may be. 13) Successful Bidders have to submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt /Perfo rmance bank Guarantee (Bank Guarantee sample format as per Annexure II of scope of work doc ument). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/C/SCR (Name of the Service Provider). Th e bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of th e pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with a covering letter. Succes sful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the buyer within 30 days of a ward of bid in GeM/ date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security. GeM contract will be issue d only after receipt of Performance Security. Exte nsion of time for submission of PG beyond 30 days and up to the date of submission of PG from the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security may be given by Dy. CEE/GS/SC However, a penal int erest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the del ay beyond 30 days (i.e from 31st day after the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG after 60 days from the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security, a notice shall be served to the contractor to deposit PG immediately however not exceeding 90 days from date of intimation. In cas e the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of intimation, a notice sh all be served to the contractor and the GeM Bid shall be cancelled duly forfeiting EMD and other dues, if an y payable against the tender. The failed Service Provider shall be debarred from participating in re-tender for that service. In case, 60th day is a bank holiday or office closure next working day should be considere d as the last day for submission of PGs, Decision Dy. CEE/GS/SC would be final in case of any dispute 14) (a) The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer

(b) The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of the buyer. (c) The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to the buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the du e performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under 15) The Service provider having non satisfactory/bad performance in previously completed contracts or cu rrent live contracts may be rejected. 16) The vehicle documents which were uploaded in the bidding process should be kept in service along wi th the Number, Model and type of vehicle’s after approval of consignee . In case, the condition of vehicle’s is not satisfactory or require replacement due to any other reason , service provider has to replace the ve hicle’s with same segment or higher segment commercial vehicle’s, mentioned in GeM SLA, as per bid con ditions with approval of user/consignee. 17) The vehicle’s should be available every day at nominated time and place as per the directions of Dy. CEE/GS/SC given from time to time. Vehicles shall/Can be parked in the Railway premises/Residence duri ng night time for emergency use as per direction of Dy. CE/GS/SC the Vehicle keys should be submitted t o the officer/authorize representative after duty hours, in case any emergency officer can use the vehicle. Minimum 30% of fuel tank capacity should be in the vehicle all the time. In case of any dispute, the decisio n of Dy. CEE/GS/SC shall be binding regarding placement and usage of vehicle for contractor. The Bill Pas sing officer is Dy. CEE/GS/SC and the Bill Paying Officer is PFA/C/SCR. 18) In case of difference between Additional tender conditions (ATC) and General tender conditions (GTC),t he terms of Additional tender conditions (ATC) will prevail. . 8.
